subject: combined-science
specSource: OCR GCSE (9-1) Gateway Science Combined Science A (J250)
qualificationNote: OCR GCSE (9-1) Gateway Science Combined Science A (J250)|Double award worth two GCSEs; tiered entry - Foundation Tier (grades 5-5 to 1-1) sits Papers 1-6 (J250/01-J250/06), Higher Tier (grades 9-9 to 4-4) sits Papers 7-12 (J250/07-J250/12); six written papers per tier, two Biology, two Chemistry, two Physics, each 1 hour 10 minutes, 60 marks, 16.7% of total GCSE; Papers 2, 4, 6 (and 8, 10, 12) assume knowledge of topics 1-3 and include synoptic assessment; no non-exam assessment; higher-tier-only content is printed in bold in the specification

B1.2.title: What happens in cells (and what do cells need)?

B3.1.title: Coordination and control – the nervous system

B3.2.title: Coordination and control – the endocrine system

C6.2.title: Interpreting and interacting with earth systems
